title: Report a nuisance dog or cat
summary: Find out what steps to take and who to contact if you have a complaint about a nuisance dog or cat.

external_links.text: Nuisance dogs and cats – Office of Local Government

faqs.q: What should I do if I have a complaint about a nuisance dog or cat?
faqs.a: You should follow the steps to take if you have a complaint, which involves contacting your local council.

faqs.q: What are the grounds for a nuisance dog or cat order?
faqs.a: A nuisance dog or cat order can be issued if the animal consistently roams, makes persistent excessive noise, endangers the health of a person or animal, or repeatedly damages property outside the property on which it is ordinarily kept.

faqs.q: Where can I find more information about nuisance pets?
faqs.a: You can find more information on nuisance dogs and cats from the Office of Local Government.
